data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, ‘Ujjwal’ is derived from the root word ‘ujj’ meaning ‘to illuminate’. This name signifies brilliance, radiance, and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Ujjwal is also the name of the god Agni, who is the god of fire, and is believed to bring light, knowledge, and warmth. The name Ujjwal carries the meaning “Lit: Radiant, brilliant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ujjwal usually hope their child will grow to embody lit: radiant, brilliant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
